english.title: Permit the use of a vehicle with flashing light
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was fitted with a lamp which

(A)_[automatically emitted a flashing light]_
(B)_[did not emit a steady light]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 13(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to the misuse of optional flashing lamps/beacons. See H273, H299 and H300 in relation to optional coloured lamps/reflectors/beacons other than red showing to the rear of the vehicle and H3097, H3098 and H3099 in relation to the use of obligatory amber warning beacons on vehicles.
(ii) See regulation 13(2) for exceptions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H2593 and H3093.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
